summary: Ground explicit Email addresses as atomic values and keep bounded sender/recipient roles scoped to workflows, source findings and exact citations.
decision_refs: The user requested a Trunk Tools-style ability to ask questions and answer from existing project files
The existing project-question route already supplies bounded selected-run evidence and inline sources
An offline reproduction proved that a sender address could be recombined from cited From and To addresses
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested file-grounded project questions modeled on Trunk Tools.
known_limitations: The address parser intentionally covers conventional ASCII dot-atom local parts and dotted DNS-style domains; quoted local parts, domain literals, SMTPUTF8 and undotted internal domains remain outside the guard.
Address roles are recognized only from explicit From, To, Cc, Bcc and Reply-To headers or bounded sender/recipient prose immediately before an address.
The guard does not infer mailbox ownership, thread participation, contractual authority, identity equivalence or whether every relevant project file was parsed.
